description: Understanding mental health, common conditions, treatments, and well-being practices

overview.definition: Mental health encompasses emotional, psychological, and social well-being; affects how we think, feel, and act
overview.prevalence: ~1 in 5 adults experience mental illness in a given year
overview.stigma: Major barrier to treatment; mental illness is medical, not weakness
overview.who_definition: A state of well-being where a person realizes their potential, can cope with normal stresses, works productively, and contributes to their community

bipolar_disorder.characteristics: Episodes of mania/hypomania alternating with depression

psychotherapy_approaches.cbt: Cognitive Behavioral Therapy; identify and change negative thought patterns; most evidence-based
psychotherapy_approaches.dbt: Dialectical Behavior Therapy; skills for emotional regulation; developed for BPD
psychotherapy_approaches.act: Acceptance and Commitment Therapy; accept difficult thoughts; commit to values
psychotherapy_approaches.psychodynamic: Explores unconscious patterns from past experiences
psychotherapy_approaches.humanistic: Person-centered; Carl Rogers; unconditional positive regard
psychotherapy_approaches.emdr: Eye Movement Desensitization and Reprocessing; trauma treatment

neurotransmitters.serotonin: Mood, appetite, sleep; SSRIs increase availability
neurotransmitters.dopamine: Reward, motivation, pleasure; low in depression; dysregulation in addiction
neurotransmitters.norepinephrine: Fight-or-flight; attention, energy; SNRIs target this
neurotransmitters.gaba: Inhibitory; reduces anxiety; target of benzodiazepines

mental_wellbeing.sleep: 7–9 hours per night; critical for emotional regulation and cognitive function
mental_wellbeing.exercise: 30 min moderate exercise 3–5× per week reduces depression/anxiety symptoms
mental_wellbeing.social_connection: Strong predictor of mental health and longevity
mental_wellbeing.mindfulness: Present-moment awareness; reduces stress; supported by neuroscience
mental_wellbeing.when_to_seek_help: Symptoms lasting 2+ weeks; significantly affecting daily functioning; thoughts of self-harm

crisis_resources.usa: 988 Suicide and Crisis Lifeline (call or text 988)
crisis_resources.principle: Crisis is temporary; help is available; reaching out is strength
